description: Fluix turns the field data your teams already capture - inspections, work orders, sign-offs and forms - into answers you get by asking. Built for operations, QHSE and field service teams running Fluix: ask which documents are overdue, what is waiting on a signature, or which inspections failed last month. Requirements and limitations: an active Fluix account on a plan that includes the MCP Server feature is required, and sign-in happens on first use. The app is read-only - it never creates, edits, signs or deletes anything - and returns only data your own Fluix permissions allow, scoped to the single company you select when you sign in. Dataset access needs the Fluix data extraction feature, and document status needs a role with access to Document status. Large result sets are returned a page at a time.

defaultPrompt: Which task reports can I access?
